niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers darker, subdued interfaces with strong focus, simplified content, and softer modern components. They repeatedly favor near-black or muted dark backgrounds over brighter or more washed-out screens, layouts with more empty space and fewer competing elements, rounded cards and controls, and cleaner presentations that reduce visual noise. They also show some secondary interest in selective warm/pink-purple accent usage, integrated card or sheet structures, and practical, clearly organized UI elements over more technical, busy, or editorial treatments.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers dark, near-black, muted interfaces with restrained contrast over bright gradients, washed-out light backgrounds, or more visually intense color treatments.
Prefers sparser layouts with more empty space, fewer competing stats or controls, and less crowded information presentation.
Prefers rounded cards, inputs, buttons, and containers with softer edges rather than squarer or harsher framing.
Prefers interfaces that isolate the primary surface clearly, such as strong background dimming and clearer focal hierarchy.
Prefers simplified rows, subtle cards, muted media treatment, and generally cleaner UI elements over busier, more technical, or high-emphasis content styling.
Prefers restrained accent colors, especially pink, red, or purple highlights, rather than cooler blue/green-heavy accent schemes.
Prefers content presented in integrated sheets, cards, or tinted structured containers with clear organization rather than flatter or more exposed element placement.
